dimensions.assessment: Involves multiple federal departments, congressional committees, and affects the offshore energy sector.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Energy, the Secretary of the Interior, and the Secretary of State

dimensions.assessment: Mandates comprehensive reporting, mapping, and updates to federal resource assessment models.
dimensions.evidence: comprehensive offshore energy resource assessment and mapping

dimensions.assessment: Requires utilization of existing maritime vessels and federal resources for assessments without specifying new spending amounts.
dimensions.evidence: utilize any existing maritime vessels or deployed capability

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Energy Policy Act of 2005 and mandates extensive interagency reports and model evaluations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 357 of the Energy Policy Act of 2005 (42 U.S.C. 15912) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Includes both one-time reporting requirements and recurring evaluations every 5 to 10 years.
dimensions.evidence: not less frequently than once every 10 years thereafter

missing_information: Specific cost figures for conducting the advanced geophysical assessments and mapping
importance_detail.rationale: Requires federal agencies to report on transboundary hydrocarbon reservoirs, update resource assessment models periodically, and conduct comparative analyses of offshore energy production practices.
